source.title: HVI: A New Color Space for Low-light Image Enhancement
source.authors: Yan, Feng, Zhang, Pang, Shi, Wu, Dong, Sun, Zhang

location: quantitative table, column 'Sony-Total-Dark', row 'CIDNet (Ours)': PSNR 22.904, SSIM 0.676
dataset_description_verbatim: Sony-Total-Dark. This dataset is a conversion of a SID subset. To make this dataset more challenging we convert the raw format images to sRGB with gamma correction, resulting in images with low brightness.
why_it_matters: Our claim that the Sony extreme-dark set is distributed in at least two renditions with different pixel conventions rests on this: the 22.904 is reported on the authors' own sRGB conversion, not on the rendition we evaluate.
